quality_guards: DSE risk depends on workstation design, equipment, posture, task duration, break pattern, lighting, training and individual factors.
HSE DSE evidence is worker-, workstation-, task-, environment-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level health probability.
Lone-worker risk depends on the task, location, supervision, communication, violence exposure, medical suitability, emergency response and worker competence.
HSE lone-working evidence is worker-, task-, workplace-, supervision-, communication- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Gas-network risk depends on pressure, demand and supply balance, network configuration, gas composition, equipment, emergency arrangements and dutyholder co-operation.
HSE gas-supply evidence is network-, operator-, emergency-, consumer-, equipment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire or exposure probability.
Brucellosis risk depends on animal species, herd status, exposure to birth material, food practices, occupation, laboratory confirmation and control timing.
Official brucellosis evidence is animal-, herd-, food-, person-, laboratory- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Psittacosis risk depends on bird species, infection status, dust generation, ventilation, exposure intensity, occupation, host factors and treatment timing.
UKHSA psittacosis evidence is bird-, environment-, exposure-, person-, laboratory- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level respiratory-infection probability.
Hantavirus risk depends on virus strain, rodent species, endemic area, exposure route, dust disturbance, travel, host factors and care timing.
UKHSA hantavirus evidence is strain-, rodent-, exposure-, traveller-, patient- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Button-battery risk depends on battery chemistry and size, product enclosure, accessibility, user age, ingestion timing and clinical response.
OPSS button-battery evidence is battery-, product-, user-, exposure-, clinical- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
E-bike battery risk depends on cell quality, battery-management design, charger compatibility, damage, modification, storage, charging behaviour and escape conditions.
OPSS e-bike evidence is product-, battery-, charger-, user-, premises- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire probability.
Bird-strike risk depends on species, flock size, season, habitat, aerodrome operations, aircraft type, flight phase and reporting practices.
CAA bird-strike evidence is aerodrome-, species-, aircraft-, operation-, event- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level accident probability.
Rail-trespass risk depends on boundary condition, electrification, train speed and frequency, local population, access history, behaviour and enforcement.
ORR trespass evidence is location-, infrastructure-, user-, operation-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level casualty probability.
Official-source context is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
